short_description: Airport engineering services for taxiways, lighting, aprons, hangars, fencing, and administration building.
project_scope: Professional airport engineering services for a broad capital improvement program at McMahon-Wrinkle Airport, including construction of a full-length taxiway on the west side of Runway 18/36; marking airfield pavements and updating runway/taxiway designations; rehabilitation of the approach ends of Runway 18/36; rehabilitation/reconstruction of airport lighting; relocation of the airfield lighting vault from the infield to the west side of the airport; rehabilitation of Taxiways B, C, D, and E; widening of Taxiway B by 150 feet over 1,800 feet; rehabilitation/improvement of the perimeter road; replacement/installation of airfield signage; installation of a wildlife perimeter fence; rehabilitation of aprons; construction of apron areas for additional hangars; construction of hangars; utility infrastructure upgrades; airfield drainage improvements; independent fee estimate services; and construction of an administration building.
services: Airport engineering and AE consulting services for planning, design, and related professional services across multiple aviation infrastructure projects; all disciplines requested.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an airport engineering framework-like services procurement covering many disciplines rather than a clearly defined structural design package.
- Scope includes civil/airside works such as taxiways, lighting, drainage, fencing, and aprons, which are generally not core sbp focus areas.
- Includes hangars and an administration building, but no structural complexity, spans, or architectural ambition are described.

construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The scope includes numerous airport-side improvements: full-length taxiway construction, runway approach rehabilitation, lighting replacement/relocation, widening Taxiway B by 150 feet over 1,800 feet, apron and hangar construction, fencing, drainage, utilities, and an administration building. This indicates a potentially substantial multi-project capital program, but no reliable USD estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice mentions independent fee estimate services but does not state the consultant fee, percentage, or budget basis.
references_qualifications: Experienced airport engineering firm with proven qualifications to provide professional airport engineering services for a full range of aviation needs; all disciplines requested.
